definitions.explanation: The capacity to endure hardship, frustration, or tedium without giving up. Emphasizes the strength or power aspect of patience.

examples.japanese: {忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧、{忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ついた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think I developed perseverance through raising children.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧ (patience, endurance) and {力|りょく} (power, ability). Emphasizes patience as a capacity or strength one possesses, rather than the act of enduring itself.

USAGE:
Commonly cited as a valued personal quality in job interviews, school contexts, and self-improvement discussions. The suffix {力|りょく} frames patience as a measurable ability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to have perseverance
- {忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — to have strong perseverance
- {忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧ — to cultivate perseverance
- {忍耐力|にんたいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ — to lack perseverance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧ — patience, endurance (the quality itself, without the "power" nuance)
- ⟦{根気|こんき}→根気：02734_konki⟧ — persistence, tenacity (sustained effort over time)
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ — endurance, tolerance (bearing discomfort or restraining oneself)
